text_en: YAH!!
How's it going, soldier?
We're training to keep us in shape while we recover.
Your general is incredible. It's amazing how easily he can move that massive sword.
HAH!!
Learning to fence is much more exciting than studying magic.
Though it would be incredible to be able to use a sword...
I know... Why don't you do me a favour? I hear stories from adventurers all the time and they always seem to match up on one thing in particular.
They often talk about a sword abandoned near the mines on the Tempes Plains.
I've always wanted to go and see it for myself when cranky Jivan lets me outside Hafin.
I think it'd be the perfect sword for me!
I spose' that, if you bring it to me, I'd have to change my mission from finding it to taking it back, once I've learnt to use it.
What'dya say? Do you accept my quest?
